data.name: Afreen
data.gender_notes: Afreen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Urdu word ‘afarana’ which means ‘to purify’. The name Afreen symbolizes the idea of being free from all impurities and evils. The name Afreen carries the meaning “Pure, Free” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Afreen usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, free and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the beautiful fragrance of faith and righteousness
data.etymology: Afreen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Free.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afreen total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: عفرين
in_arabic.meaning: عفرين اسم علم مؤنث يعود أصله إلى العبرية، ومعناه المبارك، أو المقدس
in_arabic.long_meaning: يعود اصل اسم عفرين إلى العبرية، ومعناه المبارك، أو المقدس، ويُستخدم هذا الاسم في اليهودية، ولكن في الإسلام، يُعتبر الاسم عالي المستوى، حيث يُشير إلى الشخص الذي يحظى بالفضل والبركة من الله. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يمتلك свойства الجود والرقة والخير. ومن أشهر الشخصيات المسلمة التي حملت هذا الاسم هي زينب بنت علي بن أبي طالب، التي كانت إحدى بنات الرسول محمد ﷺ وآل علي، ومن المعروف عنها أنها كانت امرأة عفيفة ومباركة.

in_english.name: Afreen
in_english.meaning: Afreen is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, meaning blessed, virtuous, or sacred
in_english.long_meaning: Afreen is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, meaning blessed, virtuous, or sacred. The name Afreen is derived from the Arabic root 'afr', which means to bless or sanctify. In Islamic tradition, the name Afreen is considered to be a high-level name, indicating a person who is blessed by God. In Arabic culture, the name Afreen is used to describe a person who is kind, gentle, and virtuous. One of the most famous Muslim women to bear this name is Zaynab bint Ali, who was a member of the Prophet Muhammad's family and was known for her piety and virtue.
